# Metrics card — GENERATED, do not edit

> **This file is generated by `tests/unit/MetricsCardTests.cs`** from `scripts/net/MotorArc.cs`,
> `scripts/net/MetricBands.cs` and `scripts/dev/playground/CalibrationPlan.cs`, evaluated at
> `MotorTuning.Default`. The test **fails if this file differs** from what it generates. Do not
> edit it by hand and do not copy its numbers into another document — cite this file. To
> regenerate after a tuning or band change: set `SAIL_REGENERATE_METRICS_CARD=1` and run
> `dotnet test tests/unit/SailNet.Tests.csproj --filter MetricsCardTests`, then commit the diff.

Every metre below is a function of the shipped motor. The band **fractions** are the spec;
the metres are what they come to today. A level is sized against the fractions, and the gym
(`Playground / Calibration`) is built from them at launch — see research A1 and LD-1.

## Speeds

| Gear | m/s | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Walk | 1.71 | `MoveSpeed × LocomotionProfile.WalkFraction` |
| Jog | 3.80 | `MoveSpeed` |
| Sprint | 6.08 | `MoveSpeed × SprintMultiplier` (`MotorArc.SprintSpeedMps`) |

## The four arcs (flat ground, as played)

| Arc | Apex | Airtime | Flat range | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Held sprint | 1.407 m | 0.667 s | 4.053 m | `MotorArc.HeldSprint` |
| Held jog | 1.407 m | 0.667 s | 2.533 m | `MotorArc.HeldJog` |
| Jog tap | 0.300 m | 0.233 s | 0.887 m | `MotorArc.JogTap` |
| Double jump at apex | 2.410 m | 1.067 s | 6.485 m | `MotorArc.DoubleJumpAtApex` |

The apex does not depend on ground speed, so a held jog and a held sprint rise the same;
only the range differs. "As played" is MOVE-3d's playground convention (the launch step out
of the apex, one tick out of the airtime). The double jump is the reachability ceiling.

## Vertical bands — ledges and step-ups (land on top, launch from flat)

| Band | Fraction of envelope | Today | Cleared by |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kerb | ≤ 100% of tap apex | ≤ 0.30 m | a tap |
| Hop | ≤ 68% of held apex | 0.30 m – 0.96 m | held jump, no run-up |
| Commit | ≤ 92% of held apex | 0.96 m – 1.29 m | held jump with a run-up |
| Edge | ≤ 100% of held apex | 1.29 m – 1.41 m | held jump, the limit |
| Technique | ≤ 93% of double-jump apex | 1.41 m – 2.24 m | double jump only |
| Denial | ≥ 108% of double-jump apex | ≥ 2.60 m | cannot |

## Horizontal bands — gaps (launch and land at the same height)

| Band | Fraction of envelope | Today | Cleared by |
|---|---|---|---|
| Stone | ≤ 95% of tap range | ≤ 0.84 m | a tap at a jog |
| Jog | ≤ 92% of held-jog range | 0.84 m – 2.33 m | held jump at a jog |
| Sprint | ≤ 92% of held-sprint range | 2.33 m – 3.73 m | held jump at a sprint |
| Edge | ≤ 100% of held-sprint range | 3.73 m – 4.05 m | held sprint, the limit |
| Technique | ≤ 93% of double-jump range | 4.05 m – 6.03 m | double jump from a sprint |
| Denial | ≥ 108% of double-jump range | ≥ 7.00 m | cannot |

A band's floor is exclusive and its ceiling inclusive: a size exactly at an envelope belongs to
the band that envelope tops. **The gap between Technique's ceiling and Denial's floor is
deliberately unnamed** — nothing is authored there. Denial is the only band the arithmetic
calls unreachable; everything else is green on the gym with the verb named.

## Band constants

| Constant | Value | Defines |
|---|---|---|
| `MetricBands.HopFraction` | 0.68 | top of Hop, × held apex |
| `MetricBands.CommitFraction` | 0.92 | top of Commit / Jog / Sprint, × the held envelope |
| `MetricBands.StoneFraction` | 0.95 | top of Stone, × tap range |
| `MetricBands.TechniqueFraction` | 0.93 | top of Technique, × the double-jump envelope |
| `MetricBands.DenialFraction` | 1.08 | floor of Denial, × the double-jump envelope |

Derived annotations the gym also prints (not band elements):

- Released-at-the-lip sprint jump lands at **1.65 m**
  (`CalibrationPlan.ReleasedSprintRangeM` — the air brake integrated over the flight; a discrete
  estimate, not a capture).
- Coyote window closes **1.14 m** past a lip at jog,
  **1.82 m** at sprint (`speed × CoyoteTimeSec`).
- Ramp to jog ≈ **0.80 m**, to sprint ≈ **2.05 m**; sprint skid ≈ **1.42 m** (closed forms, `v²/2a`).

## What this card cannot say yet

- **Drops extend range.** Every arc here is flat ground; a gap with a height delta is authored
  by feel until `MotorArc.HeldSprintRangeAtDrop(dropM)` exists (research A1, a later packet).
- **Lateral air control** has no derivation; the gym's redirect pads carry no verdict.
- **Corridor and door widths** need the body's collision radius as a named constant
  (`AvatarProportions.CapsuleRadiusM` is per-avatar, from the mesh bounds); no width band yet.
- **Slopes** have no band — the motor reads no floor normal.
